description: THE ONLY Renovate config file — do not add another (a second config file such as .github/renovate.json5 silently shadows this one; see the same note in shapepipe).
forkProcessing is enabled because this repo is a GitHub fork of martinkilbinger/shear_psf_leakage; Renovate skips forks by default.

Same policy shape as shapepipe / sp_validation / cs_util (weekly grouped non-major PR, majors gated behind a dashboard-approval tick, security fixes off-schedule), with one difference: NOTHING automerges here, because the repo has no CI — Renovate with no status checks would merge blind. Turn on automerge for non-majors once a test workflow exists. Poetry owns resolution (poetry.lock); rangeStrategy=update-lockfile means in-range releases land as lockfile bumps rather than pyproject edits.
